notes.title: August 16, 2019: NEW Graphics Engine! A whole new game!
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35417582/78a487021c4f99031a173e51101c76e813b43a92.jpg[/img]
Hi guys,
we were working with an engine that didn't deliver all the graphics that we could.

[b]WE CHANGED EVERYTHING![/b]

What is different in today's update:
- all shaders.
- all textures.
- more detailed genitals.
- high definition 3D models.
- lights and fogs.
- skies.

We rebuilt all shaders, all lights, improved the details of 3D models! The new graphics are AMAZING! Very very realistic! 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35417582/abd4f1c138d3707fb7e6b65bcc1433b7de37865c.jpg[/img]

Everyone that gave us a bad review about that, sorry! 

We are working really hard to solve all the issues that you mentioned. But graphics were the main problem reported for you and I think that our recent changes will impress you now!
